examples.name: External icon button composition
examples.description: Wrap an Icon Button in Tooltip only when the hint says more than its name; Icon Button leaves its own tooltip out inside a Tooltip, so the two never stack.
examples.jsx: <Tooltip content='Search matters by name or number'><IconButton aria-label='Search' tooltip={false}><SearchIcon /></IconButton></Tooltip>

props.content: Search matters by name or number

examples.name: Supplemental clarification
examples.description: truncate={false} wraps a longer hint (at 240px) instead of ending it with an ellipsis on one line.
examples.jsx: <Tooltip content='Supplemental clarification' truncate={false}><IconButton aria-label='More actions' tooltip={false}><MoreVertIcon /></IconButton></Tooltip>

examples.name: A short hint on a labelled Button
examples.description: The trigger keeps its own name; the tooltip adds a description people can do without.
examples.jsx:
<Tooltip content="Exports the visible rows as a CSV file">
  <Button>Export</Button>
</Tooltip>

props.content: Exports the visible rows as a CSV file

examples.name: Disabled trigger
examples.description: Tooltip wraps a disabled trigger in a span so hovering still shows the tooltip. Keyboard users can't reach it, so keep it to what the control does.
examples.jsx:
<Tooltip content="Export the selected rows">
  <IconButton aria-label="Export" disabled>
    <DownloadIcon />
  </IconButton>
</Tooltip>

examples.name: Longer delay
examples.description: delay is the milliseconds between hover or focus and showing the tooltip; it defaults to 300.
examples.jsx:
<Tooltip content="Copy the matter number" delay={600}>
  <IconButton aria-label="Copy">
    <CopyIcon />
  </IconButton>
</Tooltip>

examples.name: Tooltip turned off
examples.description: disabled turns the tooltip off without unmounting the child. It isn't the trigger's disabled state.

antiExamples.name: Explaining why a control is disabled
antiExamples.reason: Keyboard users can't reach a tooltip on a disabled control. Put the reason in visible helper text, such as Field's message.
antiExamples.jsx: <Tooltip content='Disabled until a record is selected'><IconButton aria-label='Edit' disabled tooltip={false}><EditIcon /></IconButton></Tooltip>

antiExamples.name: The tooltip as the only name
antiExamples.reason: A tooltip is only a description, and only while it shows, so this button has no name. Give the trigger its own name: visible text, or aria-label on an icon-only control.

antiExamples.name: Repeating an Icon Button's name
antiExamples.reason: Icon Button already shows its aria-label as a tooltip on its own. Wrap it in Tooltip only when the hint should say more than its name.

antiExamples.name: Interactive content in the tooltip
antiExamples.reason: Tooltip text is read as a description, not content people can move to, so a link inside it can't be reached. Use Popup for floating content with links, buttons, or fields.
